plain_english_policy: This bill directs a specific salary increase for certain employees within Alabama's Department of Corrections who work inside security fences (such as correctional facilities and work release centers). The policy mandates an immediate one-time raise followed by annual increases until the total adjustment reaches 10%, separate from standard merit raises or cost-of-living adjustments. This action aims to improve compensation specifically for staff operating within secure environments.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would produce a permanent, structured increase in wages for eligible corrections employees working inside security perimeters. The policy direction is one of targeted financial relief and retention support for this specific workforce segment, distinct from general state employee raises or inflation adjustments.
sponsorship_supports_position: The bill's sponsors affirmatively advanced legislation to increase compensation for corrections staff working inside security fences. The text explicitly mandates these increases without condition regarding the sponsor's broader stance on criminal justice reform or prison conditions beyond this specific wage adjustment.
evidence_quotes: "all Merit System employees of the Department of Corrections who... work inside a correctional facility under the care, custody, and control of the department... shall receive a one-step, 2.5 percent, salary increase."
"The salary increases provided herein shall not affect normal annual merit raise considerations.""
